title: Visit each item
summary: PHP: Visit each item. Add 6 to the list.
introduction: foreach repeats its block for every item in an array. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
$n receives 2, then 4. Each pass echoes its current value and a newline.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use the loop variable inside the block, not the whole array.
